FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 19/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-03/2026
It is hereby notified that on 19.10.2026,
21.10.2026, 22.10.2026 and 23.10.2026;
(1) Hon’ble Mr. Justice N.S.Sanjay Gowda would not be
available for Judicial as well as Administrative work.
(2) Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Ms. Justice Sangeeta K.
Vishen and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Utkarsh Thakorbhai Desai)
would take up the matters notified in the Cause list of
Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice N.S.Sanjay
Gowda and Hon’ble Mr. Justice J. L. Odedra.)
(3) Hon’ble Mr. Justice J. L. Odedra would sit Single on
19.10.2026 and take up the matters at Sr. No. 142 to
190 notified before Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr.
Justice Mool Chand Tyagi.)
By Order of Hon’ble The Acting Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
